requested_outcome: Publish one cumulative VII release containing the verified v918 night-price fix and the complete v919 candidate fixes, and make every site-join request reach Liran's service inbox while the submitter receives one idempotent receipt email.
natural_destination: https://vii.spaplus.co and the production VII lead ingestion service at https://app.spaplus.co/api/integrations/vii-leads
authorization_boundary: Adir explicitly authorized completing and publishing the cumulative VII fixes and ensuring Liran receives the requested emails. No purchases, subscriptions, unrelated deployments, destructive data changes, or guessed recipients are authorized.

lesson_bundle.reason: The task combines many previously saved fixes and a production integration, so one repaired detail cannot stand in for the complete release.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Map the cumulative affected family, run focused and broad tests, verify the exact public build, and exercise the critical journeys after publication.

lesson_bundle.reason: The public VII destination has multiple historical release sources and must preserve rollback and predecessor assets.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Prove source ancestry, release identity, rollback source, retained assets, public headers, and an old-tab continuity check.

lesson_bundle.reason: Liran's request is about the real lead-delivery outcome, not only form acceptance or code presence.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Verify persist-before-notify behavior, exact service recipient, submitter receipt, idempotency, failure handling, and production delivery evidence.

lesson_bundle.reason: Production email is an external communication with recipient and duplicate-delivery risk.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Use a stable submission identity, verify sender and recipients, do not retry uncertain sends, and retain a provider receipt.

lesson_bundle.reason: The cumulative candidate changes shared search, loading, slider and mobile behavior.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Test desktop, 390-pixel mobile, reload, route transitions, overlays and return states without stale locks or overflow.

lesson_bundle.reason: Past technical checks missed visibly broken public mobile states.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Capture and independently inspect the exact public mobile release with meaningful visible content.

lesson_bundle.reason: The candidate touches shared galleries, search, joins and world surfaces.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Verify the affected world and component family rather than only the reported example.

lesson_bundle.reason: The public product and email receipts contain Hebrew.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Verify approved Hebrew fonts and rendered RTL direction in the public UI and actual email output.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Only the latest night-price fix is live while the saved v919 fixes remain on another branch.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Create one clean release branch from the exact public v918 commit and cherry-pick the v919 candidate before any new change.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The final release ancestry contains both ee786c40 and 63368895 and the public build header matches the final commit.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The form says success but Liran does not receive the request.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Extend the production ingestion contract to all join worlds and add a dedicated service-copy recipient without replacing existing recipients.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: A controlled production join creates one stored submission, one service email to Liran and one receipt to the submitter with provider evidence.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A retry or double click creates duplicate leads or duplicate email.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Keep the same submission ID through retries and use one deterministic provider idempotency key with persisted duplicate detection.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Submitting the same controlled identity twice yields one stored record and no second provider email.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The cumulative fixes compile but break sliders, search, galleries or mobile layout.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Run focused affected-family tests, full suite, build, release gates and exact public desktop/mobile journeys.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The exact deployed build passes the route and interaction matrix with no new console or network errors.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Publication overwrites retained assets or cannot be rolled back.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Use the documented VII retained-asset publication workflow and bind evidence to the exact predecessor and candidate digest.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Retention, identity, rollback and old-tab continuity receipts all pass.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The UI says an email was sent even when the provider did not confirm it.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Display receipt success only when the upstream returns an explicit email-delivery result and return actionable failure otherwise.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Success and failure fixtures prove truthful user feedback, and the live controlled send has provider confirmation.

affected_family: VII public source ancestry and deployment identity
all join-form worlds and validation states
production lead persistence and email delivery

sources.label: VII master release and retention requirements
Liran email requirements L08 and LIRAN-29

midpoint_gate.trigger: After clean ancestry merge and focused lead-contract tests, before broad build and production publication.
checks: The cumulative branch contains both previous commits without dropped files.
All join worlds require valid email and return truthful receipt state.
The production ingestion code preserves existing recipients while explicitly adding Liran and deduplicating addresses.

attack_questions: Can the public header point to a build that omits either v918 or v919?
Can Liran miss a non-vacation join even while the form reports success?
Can a duplicate submission create a second email or lead?
Can a shared search, slider or gallery route regress on mobile after publication?
Can an old open tab request an asset removed by the new release?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Exact public VII build headers, live desktop/mobile journeys, production lead storage evidence and provider email receipt bound to a controlled submission ID.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Focused test logs, full suite/build/release gates, retained-asset receipt and a representative public route matrix across all affected worlds.

effectiveness.baseline: Public v918 contains the night-price fix but not v919. Production lead email sends only for vacation joins and the service-copy recipient is not independently proven in the release evidence.
effectiveness.target: One cumulative public build, zero dropped candidate fixes, one idempotent service email to Liran for every controlled join world, one submitter receipt, and no new high or critical public regression.
